theme_strategy: Light Theme Priority (Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy). Emphasizing 'Komorebi' (sunlight filtering through trees) with soft natural tones, airy whitespace, and a calm, premium experience.

typography.guidelines: Use Light (font-light) for elegant, large headings. Use Manrope for high-legibility UI elements (booking forms, dashboard data). No generic sans for headings.

colors.guidelines: Avoid harsh #000000 or #FFFFFF without context. Use bone-white/sand for backgrounds to feel organic. Text should be deep charcoal. Borders should be subtle stone colors.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-16 for containers. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

customer_booking_flow.mobile: Single-column, mobile-first responsive. Full-width sticky CTA for booking.
customer_booking_flow.desktop: Richer multi-column layout. Split-screen: Left side features the 3D 'table map' or rich cafe imagery, Right side features a scrolling date/time picker and booking form (side-by-side).
customer_booking_flow.alignment: Left-align forms and dense content. Center-align hero text only if it improves visual balance.

admin_dashboard.grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
admin_dashboard.style: Subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius), flat rectangular cards with 1px border (#E6E2DA). Avoid excessive shadows.

motion_and_3d.philosophy: Tasteful, lightweight, and performant. Never at the cost of load speed.
motion_and_3d.hero_image: Subtle 3D-tilted effect using framer-motion (e.g., rotateX and rotateY mapped to mouse position) to give depth without heavy WebGL.
motion_and_3d.parallax: Soft parallax on scroll for background elements to simulate 'sunlight filtering' depth.
motion_and_3d.table_map: 2.5D Isometric animated illustration using framer-motion or basic CSS 3D transforms. Interactive hover states on tables (glow or slight lift).
motion_and_3d.micro_interactions: Smooth hover lifts (-translate-y-1) and soft shadows on cards. Entrance animations staggered for lists.

components_and_surfaces.headers: Crystal Glass variant: bg-white/70 with backdrop-blur-xl, 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/40). MUST have logo and clear navigation.
components_and_surfaces.buttons: Pill-shaped or soft-rounded (rounded-full or rounded-lg). Primary buttons use brand green (#5E7153) with clear hover states.
components_and_surfaces.cards: Neumorphism/Tactile variant: Match parent background, 1px subtle border (border-[#E6E2DA]), soft shadow on hover.
components_and_surfaces.forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Inputs should have subtle backgrounds (bg-stone-50) and focus rings (focus:ring-brand-primary).
components_and_surfaces.shadcn_customizations: Override default Vercel-look. Soften radii, use stone/sand grays instead of cool slates.

hero_komorebi.description: Wooden table by a large window overlooking trees. Use for Hero section or 3D tilt effect.

elegant_coffee.description: Elegant coffee latte on a marble table with a magazine.

zen_interior.description: Warm, zen Japanese cafe architecture with people sitting.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use text-shadow over images. NO pure transparent backgrounds under text.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus states with higher contrast than default. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#5E7153]
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Provide aria-hidden on decorative 3D elements.

testing.data_testid: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='booking-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for all components. Do NOT use .tsx or TypeScript.
Implement the 'Komorebi' vibe using the designated colors. It should feel like a high-end, calm nature retreat.
Use 'framer-motion' for the 3D-tilted hero image and 2.5D animated table map to ensure it's performant and lightweight. Avoid heavy WebGL unless absolutely necessary.
For the Customer Booking flow on desktop, build a side-by-side layout: left side shows the live table map or imagery, right side houses the date/time picker and form.

For the Admin Dashboard, use a dense 'Bento Grid' layout. Make sure it feels distinctly different from the customer-facing pages (more functional, slightly tighter spacing) but retains the brand colors.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons with strokeWidth={1.5} for elegance.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., booking confirmations, admin actions).
Ensure all Shadcn components (forms, dialogs, dropdowns) are stripped of their default 'Vercel' look and customized to match the Organic & Earthy theme.
Implement both the Customer routes and the Admin/Super Admin protected routes seamlessly.
NEVER use generic placeholder text or dummy image URLs. Only use the provided Unsplash URLs.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or dropdowns. Apply backdrop-blur and a semi-solid color.
Add 'data-testid' to every button, form input, and interactive element.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
